docs.title: Internship Completion Certificate
docs.desc: Formal completion credential, only after verified internship requirements and authorised issuer approval.

docs.title: Internship Participation Certificate
docs.desc: Confirms participation only; show true programme dates and duration. Does not imply completion or academic credit.

docs.title: Training / Learning Certificate
docs.desc: Confirms a named training module and verified learning hours.

docs.title: Attendance Certificate
docs.desc: Confirms recorded attendance for specified dates/sessions; never substitutes for a completion certificate.

docs.title: Internship Experience Certificate
docs.desc: Describes actual role, organisation, dates, tasks and supervisor.

docs.title: Project Completion Certificate
docs.desc: Confirms a project deliverable and review status.

docs.title: Merit / Excellence Certificate
docs.desc: Confirms a defined merit award with rubric, score and award authority.

docs.title: Skill Competency Certificate
docs.desc: Confirms assessed competencies; name the assessment standard and level.

docs.title: Appreciation Certificate
docs.desc: Recognition of contribution; not an academic completion credential.

docs.title: Special Recognition / Owner Award
docs.desc: Platform recognition award clearly marked non-credit unless separately authorised.

docs.title: Annexure I - Student Consent Letter
docs.desc: Student consent and programme particulars; retain signed copy.

docs.title: Annexure II - Internship Acceptance Letter
docs.desc: Host organisation acceptance and assigned supervisor.

docs.title: Annexure III - IPO Completion Certificate
docs.desc: Host organisation certifies actual internship work and duration.

docs.title: Annexure IV - Department Certificate
docs.desc: Department/college certification by authorised institutional signatory.

docs.title: Annexure V - Internship Report Cover Page
docs.desc: Report title page and identity/programme fields.

docs.title: Attendance Register
docs.desc: Daily date-wise time-in/time-out and validated attendance entries.

docs.title: Daily / Weekly Logbook
docs.desc: Activity, learning outcome, actual hours, supervisor initials and evidence.

docs.title: Internship Offer / Allotment Letter
docs.desc: Offer details, scope, dates, host, terms and conditions.

docs.title: Joining / Onboarding Confirmation
docs.desc: Joining date, reporting person, orientation and access checklist.

docs.title: Parent / Guardian Consent
docs.desc: Use where required by applicable law, age and institutional policy.

docs.title: Mentor / IPO Supervisor Evaluation
docs.desc: Competency rubric, comments, evidence and recommendation.

docs.title: Academic Evaluation & Marks Sheet
docs.desc: Report, viva, internal/external marks and result with policy version.

docs.title: Report Declaration & Originality Statement
docs.desc: Student declaration of authorship, references and permitted assistance.

docs.title: Report Index & Evidence Register
docs.desc: Chapter list, artefact links, approvals and evidence custody.

docs.title: NOC / College Permission / Recommendation
docs.desc: Draft only; must be signed by an authorised institutional officer.

docs.title: Extension / Schedule Change Approval
docs.desc: Approved revised dates and effect on planned hours.

docs.title: Withdrawal / Discontinuation Record
docs.desc: Reason, effective date, work completed and disposition.

docs.title: Student / IPO / Faculty Feedback Form
docs.desc: Structured feedback for programme improvement.

docs.title: Credential Verification Summary Slip
docs.desc: Minimal public-facing credential record and status.

docs.title: Intern ID Card
docs.desc: Identity and cohort card; no unnecessary personal data.

docs.title: Internship Report Master Template
docs.desc: Full editable report structure with chapters, evidence, reflections, references and annexures.

docs.title: Host Organisation Internship MoU / Agreement
docs.desc: Draft collaboration agreement with host organisation; legal review and authorised signatures required.
